title: German Wrap Delight
description: A flavorful and satisfying wrap filled with tangy pickled cucumbers, sharp cheddar cheese, and savory German sausage.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the German sausage for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches 160°F (71°C).
Transfer the cooked sausage to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the pickled cucumbers and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined.
Warm the large flour tortilla in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked sausage, cucumber-cheddar mixture, and any desired additional toppings onto the tortilla.
Roll the wrap tightly and slice in half.
